claims.evidence: Witness report shows a bicycle with front suspension fork and knobby tyres, but does not confirm dual shock/rear suspension, and does not confirm the wheel size as 26 inches.
No photo evidence can confirm design quality; only general frame presence is described.
Witness notes knobby tyres but does not report tread depth, sidewall condition, punctures, or cracks.
Dual disc brakes are visible, but no test of brake bite/actuation or gear shifting performance is shown.
No specific adjustable components (seatpost, stem, suspension settings) are confirmed in the witness observations.
No receipt/date proof or odometer/service record is shown.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not cover rust inspection, drivetrain wear, or whether parts are original.

risks.risk: Wheel size may not be 26 inches (could be 27.5/29), affecting compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing the tyre size marking (e.g., 26x1.95) on the sidewall of the front tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size MTB/road-MTB hybrid with potential mismatch risk.

risks.risk: It may not be a true dual-suspension (rear shock) bike; witness only confirms a front suspension fork.
risks.proof: A clear side shot showing the rear suspension linkage/shock (or lack of it) near the rear triangle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a front-suspension hardtail rather than dual-suspension.

risks.risk: Brake performance may be poor (worn pads/rotors, misalignment, air in hydraulic lines, or cable issues).
risks.proof: A short video clip of braking from a standstill showing strong bite and no rubbing/warping, plus close-ups of brake pads/rotors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes needing service/parts (pads/rotors adjustment) until proven.

risks.risk: Drivetrain wear (chain stretch, cassette/chainring wear) and gear indexing may be bad even if gears exist.
risks.proof: A clip showing gear shifting across all gears smoothly, plus a close-up of the chain and cassette/chainrings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drivetrain may need overhaul (chain + possible cassette/chainring).

risks.risk: Tyre condition may be worse than it looks (dry rot, sidewall cracks, punctures, low tread).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres’ sidewalls and tread, including any puncture patches or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Frame size and fit may be unsuitable (seat tube length/geometry), reducing buyer value.
risks.proof: A measurement photo: seat tube length (from top of seat tube to bottom bracket) or a clear size label/sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a lower level due to uncertain fit.

risks.risk: Hidden damage (cracks/dents) not visible from the single angle could make it unsafe.
risks.proof: Multiple angles: close-ups of head tube, bottom bracket area, seat stays, and weld joints; plus a straight-edge check for wheel alignment (video).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the tyre sidewall showing the exact size (e.g., 26x...).
Side shot confirming whether there is rear suspension shock/linkage (dual suspension) or it’s a hardtail.
Video of braking from a standstill (front and rear) showing strong bite and no rotor rubbing.
Video of gear shifting through all gears with the bike stationary and then rolling slowly.
Close-ups of chain, cassette/chainrings, and brake pads/rotors.
Close-ups of tyre tread and sidewalls (look for cracks, punctures, dry rot).
Photos of frame for hidden cracks/dents: head tube, bottom bracket, weld joints, seat stays, and rear triangle.
Photo/measurement of frame size (seat tube length) or any size label.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a KONG bicycle with front suspension, knobby tyres, and visible dual disc brakes, but key value drivers (wheel size, whether it’s truly dual-suspension, tyre/drivetrain/brake condition, and frame size) are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be too unreliable.
